summary.en: 从销售订单、客户PO、交货或发票出发，追踪到FI清账和回款状态。

zh: 严格只读，不创建或修改SAP凭证
凭据和敏感业务数据不得写入报告
en: Strictly read-only; never creates or changes SAP documents
Fixtures never masquerade as live evidence
Credentials and sensitive business data are excluded from reports

purpose.en: Extract query objects while preserving ambiguity.

purpose.en: Run health and authoritative schema checks.

en: Read business evidence with server filters, narrow fields and complete pagination.

en: Create evidence with run id, provenance, read-only flag and pagination state.
